thread:
Alice Johnson: FYI — NovaBank is reporting a spike in embed tail latency after last night's rollout. CS flagged this as a potential SLA breach; they need a mitigation timeline. @eng-sre please advise.
Bob Li: Looking at traces now. Seeing queue growth on pool-dedicated-2 and higher CPU stalls on the kernel side.
Claire Mendez: Customer says p95 ~1.2s but p99 up to 2.4s for /v1/embeds. They want an interim workaround before EOD. What's our shortest path to relief?
Dave Ortiz: I can own traffic gating. Short plan: 1) route NovaBank to pool-dedicated-1 where model-v1-q4 is already warmed (expected 30m), 2) reduce batch_size for that route to 8 (apply config change, ~15m), 3) monitor 30m. Need infra signoff for routing change.
Eve Park: infra ok to grant routing change, but we'll need a PR and a canary rollout. I can review — estimate PR + review 45m, deploy ~10m after canary.
Bob Li: Preparing a minimal change to override route batch settings. Also collecting perf traces and kv cache stats.
Claire Mendez: CS needs a concrete customer-facing mitigation ETA. Can we commit to <=1hr for mitigation?
Dave Ortiz: Committing to routing + batch override within 1 hour. If that doesn't stabilize, fallback is to move customer to hosted burst (temporary) while we fix autoscaler.
Frank Liu: FYI moving to hosted requires account + billing approvals for burst credits. @Alice Johnson can you pre-clear with the account team if we need it?
Alice Johnson: On it — reaching out to accounts now. Also please capture request IDs and token counts; finance may need to reconcile billing if we switch tiers.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued — PR #4123 draft created by @Eve Park, will run canary jobs.
Eve Park: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4123 (draft). Config snippet:
```
routes:
  - name: nova-bank-embeds
    path: /v1/embeds
    model: model-v1-q4
    pool: pool-dedicated-1
    batch_size: 8
```
Bob Li: Running smoke test now: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeds -d @sample.json` — initial samples show reduced tail latency locally.
Dave Ortiz: Routing override applied to canary, routing verified against 10% of Nova traffic.
Eve Park: PR merged and promoted after canary. Deploy logs: all healthy. Canary -> prod promotion complete.
Bob Li: Batch_size rollback in prod config applied. Observed immediate improvement: p99 from ~2.4s -> ~0.9s on sampled traces.
Alice Johnson: CS updated and told customer we implemented a temporary mitigation. They'll hold escalation for 2 hours while we monitor. Marking mitigated for now, but please open a post-mortem and follow-up on autoscaler tuning. :white_check_mark:
Dave Ortiz: I'll own follow-up and post-mortem. Adding a task in board and will ping infra for autoscale tuning.
Claire Mendez: Thanks all — please continue to update this thread with any regressions. :pray:
